import json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from igel import Igel
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d); r=p/'results'; Igel.results_path=r; Igel.default_model_path=r/'model.joblib'; Igel.description_file=r/'description.json'; Igel.prediction_file=r/'pred.csv'; Igel.evaluation_file=r/'evaluation.json'
 pd.DataFrame({'a':[1,2,3,4], 'alias':[1,2,3,4], 'constant':[5]*4, 'other':[4,3,2,1], 'target':[2,4,6,8]}).to_csv(p/'train.csv',index=False)
 (p/'config.json').write_text(json.dumps({'dataset':{'features':{'include':['alias','a','constant','other'],'drop_constant':True,'drop_duplicate':True}},'model':{'type':'regression','algorithm':'LinearRegression'},'target':['target']}))
 Igel(cmd='fit',data_path=str(p/'train.csv'),yaml_path=str(p/'config.json'))
 desc=json.loads((r/'description.json').read_text()); print('SCHEMA',desc['input_features'],desc['dropped_features'],desc['duplicate_feature_aliases']); assert desc['input_features']==['alias','other']; assert (r/'feature_schema.joblib').exists()
 pd.DataFrame({'other':[4,3], 'a':[1,2], 'extra':[9,9]}).to_csv(p/'predict.csv',index=False)
 pred=Igel(cmd='predict',data_path=str(p/'predict.csv'),model_path=r/'model.joblib',description_file=r/'description.json',prediction_file=r/'pred.csv'); print('PREDICTIONS',pred.predictions.to_numpy().tolist())
 pd.DataFrame({'other':[4,3], 'a':[1,2], 'alias':[1,9]}).to_csv(p/'bad.csv',index=False)
 try: Igel(cmd='predict',data_path=str(p/'bad.csv'),model_path=r/'model.joblib',description_file=r/'description.json',prediction_file=r/'pred.csv')
 except ValueError as e: print('EXPECTED CONFLICT',e)
 else: raise AssertionError('conflict not detected')
